gloss: it goes without saying; needless to say

definitions.gloss: it goes without saying; needless to say; obviously
definitions.explanation: An adverbial expression used to introduce something the speaker considers self-evident or universally understood. Literally 'without even needing to say it.'

examples.japanese: {言|い}うまでもなく⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧なことだ。
examples.english: It goes without saying that this is important.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{言|い}うまでもない。
examples.english: Needless to say, health is important.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{言|い}うまでもなく、⟦{人柄|ひとがら}→人柄：08163_hitogara⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧すばらしい。
examples.english: His ability goes without saying, and his character is also wonderful.

notes:
Literally 'without it reaching the point of saying' — composed of ⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to say) + ⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧ (until) + ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (even) + ⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧ (without). Expresses that something is so obvious it does not need to be stated.

FORMS:
- {言|い}うまでもなく — adverbial form, used mid-sentence
- {言|い}うまでもない — predicate form, used at the end of a clause
- {言|い}うまでもないことだ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ — 'this is obvious, but...' (used to preface something)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {言|い}うまでもなく、〜 — Needless to say, ...
- 〜⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{言|い}うまでもない — ... goes without saying
- 〜⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{言|い}うまでもなく、〜⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ — not only ..., but also ...

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦もちろん→もちろん：01224_mochiron⟧ — of course; less formal, used in everyday speech
- むろん — of course; literary variant of ⟦もちろん→もちろん：01224_mochiron⟧
- ⟦{当然|とうぜん}→当然：01591_touzen⟧ — naturally; focuses on logical expectation rather than rhetorical emphasis

REGISTER:
Somewhat formal. Common in writing, speeches, and structured arguments. In casual speech, ⟦もちろん→もちろん：01224_mochiron⟧ is more natural.
